infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: HealthGuard needs access to your health data to monitor heart rate and detect anomalies.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: HealthGuard needs to write health data to keep your records updated.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: HealthGuard needs your location to find nearby hospitals and for emergency services.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: HealthGuard needs continuous location access during emergencies to share with emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HealthGuard uses the microphone for voice input with the AI assistant.
